verified_behaviors: Square, landscape, and portrait requests were accepted across the tested 1K, 2K, and 4K suggestions.
The auto size and all four quality values were accepted.
The stable saved result format was PNG.
Both inline Base64 image data and HTTPS image URL responses produced a usable local image.
implementation_use: The Skill maps user requests to tested size and quality suggestions without adding creative content.
The native tool validates exact sizes and keeps one final image in the user images directory.
Each requested image uses one API call; multiple images use separate calls instead of n.
The output name follows the image subject, avoids nested directories, and never overwrites an existing image.
Raw API responses and duplicate image payloads are not retained as V0.4.0 user output.
